observations: Photo 0 shows a DSLR camera body held in a hand, with 'Nikon' text visible on the front of the body.
A lens is mounted on the camera with the lens cap on, so no lens model text is visible.
No LCD screen, memory card slot, battery compartment, top dial, or serial number plate is visible in this single photo.
A watermark 'STARSHOOT IMAGE' overlays the photo.
Only one photo provided; no back, top, or side views of the body or lens barrel markings.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 confirms 'Nikon' branding but the D810 model designation is not legible anywhere on the visible body; no top-plate or clear nameplate shot provided.
A lens is attached in photo 0 but its barrel is largely obscured by hand and lens cap; no focal length or brand markings are readable.
Condition of sensor, LCD, shutter count, and internal mechanism cannot be assessed from an exterior hand-held shot alone.

risks.risk: Camera body may not be the D810 model as claimed, affecting value significantly.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the top-plate model nameplate or the rear/front body with visible 'D810' engraving.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unspecified/entry-tier Nikon DSLR body, not as a D810

risks.risk: Lens may not be the stated 24-70mm or may be a cheaper/kit lens.
risks.proof: Photo of the lens barrel showing focal length and brand/model text, with cap removed.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unidentified generic lens, lowest tier

risks.risk: Shutter count and sensor condition unknown, could be heavily used or have dead pixels/dust.
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or EXIF data, plus a test photo showing sensor/image quality.
risks.if_unproven: priced as high shutter-count / unverified sensor condition

risks.risk: Functionality (power-on, autofocus, screen, buttons) not demonstrated.
risks.proof: Short video clip showing camera powering on, lens autofocusing, and screen/menu operating.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, memory card, strap, box) not shown, which affects bundle value.
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body and lens only, no accessories

risks.risk: Possible cosmetic or physical damage (cracks, mount wear, fungus in lens) hidden by angle/hand placement.
risks.proof: Multiple angle photos: top, rear LCD, lens mount, and lens elements against light.

proof_requests: Clear top-plate photo showing the 'D810' model engraving.
Photo of the lens barrel (cap off) showing focal length and brand markings.
Photo or screenshot of shutter count / EXIF data.
Video of camera powering on, autofocusing, and screen functioning.
Photo of all accessories included in the sale (battery, charger, card, strap, box).
response.reason: The single photo only confirms a Nikon-branded DSLR body; the specific D810 model designation and the 24-70mm lens claim are not legible or visible, so even a worst-case price cannot be anchored to the claimed model without a clearer identifying shot.
